size.note: Confirmed via an official cancilleria.gob.ar-hosted requirements PDF for the 'rentista' visa subcategory (4x4cm, white background) — matches DB exactly. Argentina's foreign ministry publishes requirements per visa subcategory across dozens of consulate subdomains rather than one master photo-spec page; other visa subcategories were not individually checked, so this confirmation should be read as representative rather than exhaustive across all Argentine visa types.
